look.why: Teal sits opposite the fox's rusty orange on the colour wheel; a soft 200 keeps it pastel.

size.measure: nose to tail tip: head and body 46–90 cm plus tail 30–56 cm, mid-range

habitat.text: Forests, tundra, deserts, farms and even cities. No wild dog roams more of the planet!

diet.text: Mice, voles and rabbits, plus bugs, fruit and leftovers. Up to 1 kg of food a day.

facts.text: Foxes pounce on mice under snow, and leaps aimed roughly north-east land far more often. A magnetic sense, maybe!
It has the widest range of any wild dog, from the Arctic Circle to North Africa.

facts: Rubah menerkam tikus di bawah salju, dan lompatan ke arah timur laut jauh lebih sering kena. Mungkin indra magnet!
Wilayahnya terluas di antara semua anjing liar, dari Lingkar Arktik sampai Afrika Utara.
